container.baileys_enchantments.enchant.b: The ancient magic sometimes grants more...
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.execute: Every strike hits 20% harder and opens a wound that bleeds for 2 damage a second over three seconds. Any foe already at or below 20% health is executed outright, whatever its health bar says.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.obliter: +5.5 damage on every arrow, and each one detonates where it lands, tearing into everything around the impact. Distance is no longer safety.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.overdri: Mines far beyond the reach of Efficiency, and breaks an entire 3x3 face in one swing. Tunnels at a walking pace.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.aegis.d: 22.5% of all incoming damage turned aside per piece worn, up to 90% for a full set. The price is your footspeed: 20% slower per piece, and a crawl in the complete set.
Fall damage is gone entirely, and a leap carries you far higher than legs alone should manage. The ground stops being a threat.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.eternal: The item stops wearing out. No durability is ever spent, by use, by damage, or by time.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.abundan: Ore drops are multiplied far past Fortune's ceiling. A vein yields what a seam should.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.plunder: Mobs give up drops they normally hoard, and give up more of them. Rare drops stop being rare.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.retribu: Every hit you take is returned in full to whoever landed it, and leaves them weakened and slowed. Attacking you becomes the mistake.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.shockwa: Each strike throws every nearby enemy away from you and leaves them slowed. Crowds stop being crowds.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.tempest: Arrows call down lightning where they strike and hurl everything near the impact away.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.lightni: Every melee hit calls a bolt of lightning onto the target. Storms follow you.
Break the base log and the whole tree comes down with it, leaves and all, in a single swing.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.multish: Three arrows leave the bow for the cost of one, spread across your aim.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.shortbo: No draw. The arrow leaves the instant you click, always at full power and always critical, limited only by how fast you can click.
Arrows correct their own flight mid-air, curving toward the nearest enemy. A near miss becomes a hit.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.shatter: Sharpness VII everywhere, and +45 damage in the Deep Dark or against anything born of it. The deep ladder's killing edge.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.silence: The deep stops hearing you. You emit no vibrations at all: sensors, shriekers and the Warden itself are blind to you, though the Warden can still smell you out at close range.
Speed, attack speed and a chance to slip a blow entirely, each scaling with how many pieces you wear. A full set is 24% faster and evades one hit in five.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.dissona: Everything Mirage gives, and a phase state held by sneaking: evade far more, take 50% more damage, reach further, and flash-step to any block you click inside a fixed 100x100 zone. Leaving the zone or releasing sneak costs a 30 second lockout.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.immorta: Aegis's protection with none of its slowness, and permanent immunity to every debuff. Press the ward key to become untouchable for 30 seconds, at the cost of half your speed and half your damage. Two minute cooldown.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.resonan: A sonic pulse on every hit, and all of Execute's perks kept intact. Right-click to begin a three second rite that drags every living thing in your chunk to you and scatters them at 20% health. You are exposed while it builds, untouchable once it lands.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.umbra.d: Smite VII against the undead. Every kill has a one in five chance to raise a fleeting shadow of the slain, which fights at your side for thirty seconds.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.requiem: Smite VII, and Arise. Your army lives in this blade. Sneak-click the remnant of anything you kill to bind its shadow; right-click to deploy them, sneak-click the air to recall. Shadows level and grow cunning as they fight. Lose the blade and you lose command of them.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.sculkba: +1 damage per level anywhere, and +6 more per level in the Deep Dark or against anything born of it. Cannot share a weapon with Sharpness, Smite or Bane of Arthropods.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.deepwar: 20% of incoming damage turned aside per level at a full set, and another 10% per level in the Deep Dark. Each level also adds armour toughness. Cannot share armour with the Protection family.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.wither_: Strikes afflict the target with Wither, draining their health over time. Cannot share a weapon with Venom or Frostbite.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.venom.d: Strikes poison the target, damaging them steadily after the blow lands. Cannot share a weapon with Wither Touch or Frostbite.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.frostbi: Strikes chill the target, slowing them heavily for a few seconds. Cannot share a weapon with Wither Touch or Venom.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.vampiri: A share of the damage you deal is returned to you as health. The longer the fight, the better it serves you.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.swiftne: Boots that carry you faster, 15% per level, at all times.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.vitalit: One extra heart per level, on every piece that carries it. A full set at maximum is eight hearts more.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.lava_wa: Lava turns solid beneath your feet, and you take no harm from it. Found only in chests or forged at the ancient table.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.auto_sm: Ore is smelted the moment it breaks. Iron and gold come out of the ground as ingots.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.vein_mi: Break one block of an ore vein and the whole vein follows, however far it runs.
baileys_enchantments.requiem.not_yours: This shadow did not fall to you.
baileys_enchantments.requiem.busy: A rite is already under way.
baileys_enchantments.requiem.blade_lost: The blade has left your hands. Your shadows return to it.
baileys_enchantments.requiem.not_your_bl: This blade answers to another hand.

baileys_enchantments.dissonance.needs_se: Dissonance sleeps: %s of 4 pieces bear it.
baileys_enchantments.immortal.no_set: Immortal sleeps until all four pieces bear it.
baileys_enchantments.necro.gate: Your shadows learn nothing more until you kill something yourself.
baileys_enchantments.army.title: SHADOW ARMY
baileys_enchantments.army.empty: No shadows bound. Kill, then Arise.
baileys_enchantments.army.stance.guard.t: Fights what fights you, and what you fight.
baileys_enchantments.army.stance.aggress: Also attacks any hostile nearby, unprovoked.
